name: io.foglift/mcp
title: Foglift: AI Search Visibility and Google Search Console
description: AI search visibility in ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, AI Overviews, plus GSC and Bing data

tools.name: scan_website
tools.description: Scan a website URL for SEO, GEO, and AI search readiness. Returns overall score, category scores (technical SEO, content quality, AI optimization, schema markup), and a list of specific issues with fix suggestions.

url.description: The full URL to scan (e.g. https://example.com)

tools.name: batch_scan
tools.description: Scan multiple URLs in one request (max 10). Returns scores and issues for each URL. Requires API key.

tools.name: run_ai_visibility
tools.description: Run an AI visibility check — query AI models (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini) with prompts related to your domain and see if they mention or recommend your brand. Returns per-model results with citation status and sentiment.

brand_id.description: Foglift brand UUID. Omit if your account has one brand; required if you have multiple. Get UUIDs at https://foglift.io/dashboard/developer.

workspace_id.description: Legacy alias for brand_id. Prefer brand_id for new integrations.

models.description: Models to test (e.g. chatgpt, claude, perplexity, gemini)

tools.name: get_ai_results
tools.description: Get historical AI visibility results for your domain. Shows how AI models have mentioned your brand over time, with sentiment and citation data.

brand_id.description: Foglift brand UUID. Omit if your account has one brand; required if you have multiple. Get UUIDs at https://foglift.io/dashboard/developer.

workspace_id.description: Legacy alias for brand_id. Prefer brand_id for new integrations.

tools.name: get_search_trace
tools.description: Get the ordered ChatGPT search trace for one AI visibility result, including search steps, queries, pages read, citation flags, run rollups, and the trailing 30-day prompt rollup when available.

result_id.description: The AI visibility result UUID returned by get_ai_results.

tools.name: get_prompts
tools.description: Get your saved AI visibility monitoring prompts. These are the prompts used to check if AI models mention your brand.

brand_id.description: Foglift brand UUID. Omit if your account has one brand; required if you have multiple. Get UUIDs at https://foglift.io/dashboard/developer.

workspace_id.description: Legacy alias for brand_id. Prefer brand_id for new integrations.

tools.name: add_prompt
tools.description: Add a new prompt to monitor for AI visibility. The prompt will be periodically tested against AI models to check if they mention your brand.

brand_id.description: Foglift brand UUID. Omit if your account has one brand; required if you have multiple. Get UUIDs at https://foglift.io/dashboard/developer.

workspace_id.description: Legacy alias for brand_id. Prefer brand_id for new integrations.

tools.name: delete_prompt
tools.description: Delete a saved AI visibility monitoring prompt by its ID.

brand_id.description: Foglift brand UUID. Omit if your account has one brand; required if you have multiple. Get UUIDs at https://foglift.io/dashboard/developer.

workspace_id.description: Legacy alias for brand_id. Prefer brand_id for new integrations.

prompt_id.description: The ID of the prompt to delete

tools.name: get_models
tools.description: Get your enabled AI models and monitoring frequency settings. Account-level setting — applies to every brand on your account.

tools.name: set_models
tools.description: Update which AI models are enabled for monitoring and the monitoring frequency. Account-level setting — applies to every brand on your account.

enabled_models.description: Map of model names to enabled status (e.g. {"chatgpt": true, "claude": false})

monitoring_frequency.description: Monitoring frequency: daily, weekly, or monthly

tools.name: get_sentiment
tools.description: Get AI sentiment analysis results — shows how AI models talk about your brand (positive, neutral, negative) with trends over time.

brand_id.description: Foglift brand UUID. Omit if your account has one brand; required if you have multiple. Get UUIDs at https://foglift.io/dashboard/developer.

workspace_id.description: Legacy alias for brand_id. Prefer brand_id for new integrations.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Get API usage statistics for your Foglift account — scan count, AI visibility checks, and quota remaining.

tools.name: get_scan_history
tools.description: Get historical scan results for a specific URL — shows how scores have changed over time.

url.description: The URL to get scan history for

tools.name: get_geo_monitor
tools.description: Get GEO monitoring data — track how your site's AI search optimization scores change over time.

brand_id.description: Foglift brand UUID. Omit if your account has one brand; required if you have multiple. Get UUIDs at https://foglift.io/dashboard/developer.

workspace_id.description: Legacy alias for brand_id. Prefer brand_id for new integrations.

tools.name: get_referrer_analytics
tools.description: Get AI-engine referrer analytics — total visits, per-engine breakdown, top landing paths, and daily trend for visitors arriving from ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot, NotebookLM, and other AI engines.

brand_id.description: Foglift brand UUID. Omit if your account has one brand; required if you have multiple. Get UUIDs at https://foglift.io/dashboard/developer.

workspace_id.description: Legacy alias for brand_id. Prefer brand_id for new integrations.

days.description: Number of days to include (default 30, max 365)

tools.name: get_crawler_analytics
tools.description: Get observed AI crawler activity for a brand, including total visits, engine and crawler-category breakdowns, distinct pages reached, top paths, and the time trend. Use this for server-observed bot access; use get_referrer_analytics for human visits arriving from AI answer links.

brand_id.description: Foglift brand UUID. Omit if your account has one brand; required if you have multiple. Get UUIDs at https://foglift.io/dashboard/developer.

workspace_id.description: Legacy alias for brand_id. Prefer brand_id for new integrations.

days.description: Number of days to include (default 30, max 365)

tools.name: get_competitors
tools.description: Compare this brand with its named competitors using current and previous monitoring windows. Returns result mention rates and percentage-point changes, with incomplete rates omitted when an evidence window reaches its cap. Use this for competitive visibility trends; use get_source_gap to find third-party citation opportunities.

brand_id.description: Foglift brand UUID. Omit if your account has one brand; required if you have multiple. Get UUIDs at https://foglift.io/dashboard/developer.

workspace_id.description: Legacy alias for brand_id. Prefer brand_id for new integrations.

days.description: Days per comparison window (default 30, max 90). The tool compares this window with the immediately preceding window.

tools.name: get_source_gap
tools.description: Find domains AI answers cite when this brand is absent, including which tracked competitors appear beside each source and an authority-based attainability signal. When authority is queued for refresh, authority and attainability remain null and authority_pending is true. Use this to prioritize citation outreach and source-layer coverage.

brand_id.description: Foglift brand UUID. Omit if your account has one brand; required if you have multiple. Get UUIDs at https://foglift.io/dashboard/developer.

workspace_id.description: Legacy alias for brand_id. Prefer brand_id for new integrations.

limit.description: Maximum source gaps to return (default 8, max 20)

tools.name: get_aeo_score
tools.description: Read the latest stored AI Readiness page score for a brand plus its score history and direction of change. This uses existing deterministic score evidence and does not run a new analysis or spend AI tokens.

brand_id.description: Foglift brand UUID. Omit if your account has one brand; required if you have multiple. Get UUIDs at https://foglift.io/dashboard/developer.

workspace_id.description: Legacy alias for brand_id. Prefer brand_id for new integrations.

url.description: Optional exact page URL. Omit to return the newest stored score across the brand.

tools.name: get_search_console
tools.description: Fetch Google Search Console or Bing Webmaster Tools data for the connected domain — top queries, top pages, and search demand with low AI visibility. Defaults to Google for backward compatibility.

brand_id.description: Foglift brand UUID. Omit if your account has one brand; required if you have multiple. Get UUIDs at https://foglift.io/dashboard/developer.

workspace_id.description: Legacy alias for brand_id. Prefer brand_id for new integrations.

type.description: Data type: 'queries' (top search queries), 'pages' (top pages), 'contested' (queries with GSC impressions but low AI visibility), or 'crawl' (Bing-only crawl and index snapshots). Default: queries

tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.description: Estimate token cost before running run_ai_visibility. Accepts the same prompt/model shape as run_ai_visibility plus brand_id. Returns estimated_tokens, current_balance, and sufficient so agents can avoid overdrawing the account before a scan.

brand_id.description: Foglift brand UUID. Omit if your account has one brand; required if you have multiple. Get UUIDs at https://foglift.io/dashboard/developer.

workspace_id.description: Legacy alias for brand_id. Prefer brand_id for new integrations.

prompts.description: Custom prompts to estimate. If omitted, active saved prompts for the brand are counted.

models.description: Models to estimate, matching run_ai_visibility (chatgpt, claude, perplexity, gemini, ai-overview).

use_saved_prompts.description: When true or when prompts are omitted, count active saved prompts for this brand.

tools.name: get_recommendations
tools.description: Get AI visibility recommendation diagnostics for a Foglift brand without spending Foglift server-side recommendation tokens. Returns weak engines, weak prompts, citation/competitor gaps, already stored Foglift or customer-agent recommendations, and a reasoning recipe. After applying a recommendation, re-run run_ai_visibility and get_ai_results to verify movement. Legacy workspace_id is accepted as an alias.

brand_id.description: Foglift brand UUID. Omit if your account has one brand; required if you have multiple. Get UUIDs at https://foglift.io/dashboard/developer.

workspace_id.description: Legacy alias for brand_id. Prefer brand_id for new integrations.

tools.name: submit_recommendation
tools.description: Submit a recommendation generated by your agent back to Foglift. Foglift stores it as source='customer_agent' for the brand and surfaces it in the dashboard and recommendation digest as generated by your agent. Include the fix, target tier or prompt, rationale, and expected impact. Legacy workspace_id is accepted as an alias.

brand_id.description: Foglift brand UUID. Omit if your account has one brand; required if you have multiple. Get UUIDs at https://foglift.io/dashboard/developer.

workspace_id.description: Legacy alias for brand_id. Prefer brand_id for new integrations.

description.description: Specific fix or change-set to make.

target_tier.description: Optional AI Visibility tier slug such as t3-brand.

rationale.description: Why this action should improve visibility.

page.description: Optional target page path or URL.

tools.name: apply_recommendation
tools.description: Prepare the next action for a stored Foglift or customer-agent recommendation. For customer-site edits, returns a precise change-set instead of modifying the site. After applying, re-run run_ai_visibility and get_ai_results to verify movement. Legacy workspace_id is accepted as an alias.

brand_id.description: Foglift brand UUID. Omit if your account has one brand; required if you have multiple. Get UUIDs at https://foglift.io/dashboard/developer.

workspace_id.description: Legacy alias for brand_id. Prefer brand_id for new integrations.

recommendation_id.description: Stored recommendation id from get_recommendations or submit_recommendation.

tools.name: generate_content_brief
tools.description: Generate a content brief for a page in the target Foglift brand, using the brand context when brand_id is provided. Use this for recommendation follow-through on content_gap or visibility_boost fixes. Legacy workspace_id is accepted as an alias.

brand_id.description: Foglift brand UUID. Omit if your account has one brand; required if you have multiple. Get UUIDs at https://foglift.io/dashboard/developer.

workspace_id.description: Legacy alias for brand_id. Prefer brand_id for new integrations.

url.description: Target page URL or path to brief.

recTitle.description: Optional recommendation title to seed the brief context.

tools.name: report_issue
tools.description: Report a bug, unexpected behavior, question, or feature request to the Foglift team. You can describe this far more precisely than a human user - please do. Include exactly what you were trying to accomplish, the precise Foglift tool/endpoint and arguments you called, the actual result vs. what you expected, any error code or message, step-by-step reproduction, and your own hypothesis about the cause. More detail = faster resolution.

brand_id.description: Foglift brand UUID. Omit if your account has one brand; required if you have multiple. Get UUIDs at https://foglift.io/dashboard/developer.

workspace_id.description: Legacy alias for brand_id. Prefer brand_id for new integrations.

summary.description: Short issue title or one-sentence summary.

type.description: Your classification hint. Foglift re-triages before routing.

tool_or_endpoint.description: Foglift MCP tool or REST endpoint involved.

request_payload.description: Arguments or request payload you sent.

error_code.description: Machine-readable error code or provider code, if any.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Return the authenticated Foglift account identity: user_id, plan, default workspace (name + domain), current token balance, and monthly allocation. Use this to confirm which account an API key is tied to.

tools.name: recommend_setup
tools.description: Calculate the sustainable monitoring prompt count from the authenticated Foglift account's persisted plan, active brands, scan frequency, and enabled engines. Returns the trusted prompt budget, category distribution, examples, and warnings. Call this BEFORE creating prompts to avoid over-spending tokens.

tools.name: apply_setup_recommendation
tools.description: Create the categorized monitoring prompts from a recommend_setup result for a specific Foglift brand. Requires brand_id, brand name, competitors, industry, and the recommendation output. Idempotent on retry. Legacy workspace_id is accepted as an alias.

brand_id.description: Foglift brand UUID. Omit if your account has one brand; required if you have multiple. Get UUIDs at https://foglift.io/dashboard/developer.

workspace_id.description: Legacy alias for brand_id. Prefer brand_id for new integrations.

brand_name.description: Customer brand name to substitute into prompt templates.

competitors.description: Known competitors to use in comparison prompts.

industry.description: Customer industry/category to substitute into prompt templates.

recommendation.description: The full structured output returned by recommend_setup.

tools.name: recipe_run
tools.description: Run a named Foglift recipe against a specific brand. First available recipe: weekly-brand-health-report, which returns a weekly AI Readiness / AI Visibility report from existing scan and monitoring data.

brand_id.description: Foglift brand UUID. Omit if your account has one brand; required if you have multiple. Get UUIDs at https://foglift.io/dashboard/developer.

workspace_id.description: Legacy alias for brand_id. Prefer brand_id for new integrations.

args.description: Optional recipe-specific arguments. brand_id is resolved by the MCP tool gate.
